content: PolicyKit1 supervision gap closed: polkit-dinit provides polkit-elogind-dinit (conversion resolves), dbus_audit_coverage harness gate (dinit, parses audit summary in installer.log). Confirmed: dinit 136/136, OpenRC 109/109. Also btrbk 0.32 config fix (snapshots now real), pages-race artifact staging live, turnstile stop-order.

Hardening family consolidated: hardening-config r2 = static sysctls 93-99 + family deps (apparmor/clamav/set-permissions); set-permissions r0 enabled at boot both inits; debug drop-in 99-feralos-debug; clamav enablement moved to the hardening-config packageLogic key (deps-installed packages need their rules keys on the family package). dinit 136/136, OpenRC 109/109 confirmed.

btrbk runs as ROOT via root's crontab; no btrbk user/group created (Alpine package creates none; dedicated user = SSH-remote scenario only). The removed run_as option was the only reason a btrbk user made sense — dropped upstream in btrbk 0.32.

Docs round: package-configs (hardening r2 family consolidation + set-permissions row + clamav-config r1 freshclam.conf), security_stack (clamav deps + enablement via hardening-config key), feature_confinement (hardening family note), storage (btrbk 0.32 syntax + the zero-snapshots story), harness artifacts (btrbk_config/btrbk_snapshot/config_packages_hardening/dbus_audit_coverage rows), variables.md (feralosRepoUrl override). Final proof: dinit 136/136, OpenRC 109/109.

hardening.go fully replaced (92 lines: gate+cmdline+debug drop-in only). Everything else lives in hardening-config r3 (sysctls 93-99 static + family deps + clamav DB post-install pull) and set-permissions r0. Regression caught en route: apparmor packageLogic key dead after consolidation — moved to the family key + harness asserts. dinit 136/136 green.

packageLogic install couplings: any INSTALLED package whose rules key carries packages pulls them at runtime (clamav-daemon → freshclam, owner directive). Mechanism: packages.go applyInstallCouplings — loops to stability, applies ONLY the packages field against the live pkg list. Enablement of dep-installed services rides the FAMILY key (hardening-config), since the re-apply iterates HardeningPackages() only.

cmdline.d round complete: hardening cmdline fragment ships in hardening-config r4 (/etc/kernel/cmdline.d/50-hardening.conf + apk trigger reassembles+rebuilds UKI on upgrade), assemble-cmdline 0.1.0-r0 in a NEW repo skea999/assemble-cmdline (Go, /usr/sbin per FHS, full blocking gate). cmdline.d: 00-base (installer) < 50-hardening (package) < 99-debug (installer, enableDebug) — per-key last wins. 50-booster hook assembles live. Proof: dinit 136/136, apparmor=1 from the package fragment in the real kernel cmdline.

OpenRC 109/109 confirmed: all config-package stack (cmdline.d, hardening family, set-permissions, btrbk, vector) green on the fallback init too. The cmdline.d/hardening/pages-race round is fully closed on both inits.

feralos-dbus-audit moved to its own standalone repo (skea999/feralos-dbus-audit, Go + full blocking CI 8 jobs; minimal shell/ core extracted). aports 0.1.2-r1 source pins the new repo tag; CI seed lesson: bump pkgrel on source change or the seeded old apk survives. Tags dbus-audit-0.1.x stay historical on feralos.

dbus-audit standalone repo CONFIRMED live: run 17-24-49Z 136/136, audit 0.1.2-r1 installed from skea999/feralos-dbus-audit, 8a auto-install 17 supervision pkgs, REPORT 32 covered/0 missing. Round closed: cmdline.d + hardening family + set-permissions + pages-race + dbus-audit new home, all verified on dinit 136/136 and OpenRC 109/109.

Full session round closed and documented: cmdline.d + hardening family + set-permissions + pages-race + dbus-audit standalone repo. Verified: dinit 136/136 (17-24-49Z), OpenRC 109/109 (16-03-10Z). Docs: package-configs, security_stack, feature_confinement, storage, artifacts, aports-pinning, dbus-activation, variables.md all updated. Repos: feralos cf13723->+docs, aports af7a56a, feralos-dbus-audit 7ce9f59/v0.1.2.

ADR-014 security split implemented: 3 variables (enableBaseSecurity/enableCompleteSecurity/enableHardening, defaults true/true/false, independent). New aports packages base-security-config r0 (apparmor stack + 40-apparmor.conf LSM fragment + cmdline trigger) and complete-security-config r0 (enterprise deps + audit.rules + aide.conf + cron; post-install existence-filtered watches); hardening-config r5 drops apparmor. Installer: 3 feature owner files, internal/security_stack.go deleted, BaselineAide in completesecurity.go (step 18). Rules family keys + standardPackages trimmed. Harness checks gated per variable. Docs + ADR-014 done.

ADR-014 proof round: 4 runs all green (dinit 138/138 flagship, OpenRC 77/77, hardening-only 57/57 zero-enterprise, complete-no-base 134/134 zero-apparmor). Two lessons: (1) harness writeHarnessVariables GENERATES the runner variables.yaml — new variable keys MUST be added there or they zero-value regardless of fixtures; (2) /sbin/fsck = busybox applet in FeralOS (dummy util-linux-misc 999.0.0 keeps real one out for uutils more) and busybox fsck resolves LABEL= tags by probing every /dev node with per-node perror — the 'fsck: /dev/fb0: No such file or directory' boot line is that probe racing the KMS simpledrm->virtio_gpu fb0 handover; ESP check completes fine; allowlisted in log_errors with full root-cause comment.

niriWayle config migration scope (2026-11-23): files under /home stay installer-written FOREVER (installer-owned + user-editable; package re-assertion on update would clobber manual changes) — config.toml and config.kdl never move to wayle-config. Vendor-file appends (pam_oo7, NoDisplay) stay installer-run-ONCE (post-install would re-assert them on every update). wayle-config carries only system-path statics: greeter.sh, feralos-reboot wrapper, /etc/pam.d/passwd. Shared niri statics = future niri-base-config.
